name: Faggio dei Baracconi, Foresta Umbra

location.address: Localita Baracconi, Foresta Umbra, Monte Sant'Angelo (FG)

official_register.name: Regione Puglia, Elenco degli alberi monumentali (CC BY 4.0), register id 23/F631/FG/16

access: Foresta Umbra is a state forest in the Gargano National Park with 15 marked trails and free trailhead parking. Trail 3 (Baracconi - Monte Maiuri - Caritate) starts at Baracconi, on the SP52bis road from Villaggio Umbra towards Vieste. The register gives no trail distance from the trailhead to the tree. Not the fenced Falascone reserve.
transport: By car or taxi from Monte Sant'Angelo or Vico del Gargano via the SS528/SS89 forest road to Villaggio Umbra; no regular public transport confirmed.

verify_notes: Register: 23/F631/FG/16, beech girth 520 cm, height 26 m, locality Baracconi, GIS point 41.819178,16.000014 (approximate, no tree-level evidence). Second source: Barinedita 2019-09-06 says the 'faggio della Foresta Umbra', also known as 'faggio dei Baracconi', is one of five Puglia trees chosen for the national volume 'Alberi monumentali d'Italia' by the Ministry, a testimony to the old Gargano beech forests, now inside the UNESCO listing (Foresta Umbra beech forests). A search-summary of a Carabinieri forest reserve booklet (rgpbio.it, PDF is a scan, not readable here) says a colossal beech at Baracconi still carries painted forestry marks on its trunk; NOT seen on a fetched page, treat as unconfirmed. Age: no source gives an age for this tree; UNESCO-related pages say Foresta Umbra beeches reach about 350 years (general, search summary only). Leave age empty. Alive: no recent dated record for this tree. lifecheck NONE at the register point, iNaturalist has beech observations 60 m away (2026-04-07, cc-by-nc, not identified as this tree). Pin: iNaturalist Fagus obs at 41.81974,16.00001 is within ~60 m but is not evidence of the monumental trunk. FINDABILITY (Italy covered country): no photo identified and no confirmed pin, so ships only if a photograph is approved from photo_candidates or a reader supplies a GPS fix.
